verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents that users can edit an agent's behavior in natural language, for example "Update your instructions so you always do it this way" or "Turn this into a skill". Its agents also take a plain-language goal and work out which tools to call and in what order. This is the product's own prompt-driven editing of agent definitions, but no evidence shows a full workflow being generated from a single prompt. missing for 10: documented generation of a complete workflow or agent from a single prompt, detail on the extent of natural-language editing (triggers, connectors, steps), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: tell it: "Update your instructions so you always do it this way" or "Turn this into a skill."
You give an agent a goal and a set of tools, and it figures out how to get there: which tools to call, in what order, and when to ask you for input.
